body:
# R25-RENDER v0.3 context-storage correction before ABI freeze

Please use current proposed header /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/renderer-helper/rally_render.h SHA256 2adcc445e416f3dd95db2f52afb7ef8803c67e6fc444556be5e9d1505b133e50 and CONTRACT-V03.md SHA256 0b1c90c8f22233ca7328155537ca9a59cbe817a90e33eab98d558dbc751db885. Original v0.2 header/proposal remain byte-preserved under proposals/v02/ for your previous hashes. No previously accepted concrete ABI is being silently changed; exact acceptance was pending.

Host stack inspection found an ordinary prepare frame of 1008 bytes with local actor arrays/copies. This is NOT native ESP32 measurement, but warrants moving scratch into caller-owned private context now. Context is 464 bytes (previously 84): bindings/header 84, snapshot 108, eight actor records 224 and order/distance arrays 48. All values, no persistent pointers/leases; per-context storage preserves interleaved isolation. Functions and bindings 76/state 108/completion 48/ready 44 remain unchanged. Context is native private storage, not wire/root footer. Target/composed stack/resource admission remains future proof, not waived by this host fix.

Revision also incorporates your separate generated app-owned 48-byte completion buffer. Glue uses typed completion local, releases all helper views, then publishes to that buffer with root+completion. Publication can fail after local ready 1, so observed SDK/helper status plus matched completion AND fresh root success is mandatory; publication failure early-returns before root-success suffix. Root header/globals shape remains unchanged, and resident ready alone never authorizes a draw. Early argument release remains required for intended peak 3.

Please accept/amend the revised concrete ABI and proposed --native-bindings / after_source_before_success manifest spelling as a CONTRACT ONLY. This does not request unapproved GOLEM-037 implementation or linking. Independent host extraction continues while your D1a review and this contract response are pending.
